div.head: III Atr 13.1
div.ab: And gif hine man mid him befare, béon hig begen ánes rihtes weorðe.
Et si inueniatur cum eo, sint ambo unius rectitudinis digni.
And gif hine man mid him befare, béon hig begen ánes rihtes weorðe.
Und wenn derselbe mit jenem [Friedbrecher] betroffen wird, seien sie beide gleicher Rechtsstrafe theilhaftig.
And if he is caught with that [peace-breaker], let them both be subject to the same legal penalty.
And if he (the accused) is found in his company, they shall both incur the same penalty.
And if he is discovered with him, they are both liable to the same penalty.

note.seg: Das Gesetz I Atr, mit dessen Nachsatz sich diese Zeile deckt, betrifft gewaltsame Verteidigung des Verbrechers. Vgl. Gl Begünstigung 7
The law I Atr, with whose apodosis this line coincides, concerns forcible defence of the criminal. Cf. Gl Begünstigung 7
Cf. IV As. 6, 3; VI, 1, 2; I Atr. 4, 2.
